overall_notes: This paper is primarily about language modeling and domain adaptation analysis, not NLG evaluation. It studies how additional pretraining affects perplexity on test sets, but does not evaluate generated text outputs. The paper focuses on understanding when additional pretraining helps or harms language modeling performance, particularly analyzing perplexity degradation on certain domains and tokens.
